summary: Mineral County, MT lookout on the Lolo National Forest: an L-4 tower built in 1936 and destroyed in 1962 per one source; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: firelookout.com says destroyed in 1962; Forest Lookouts says Removed and the FFLA county list says Tower Gone

events.note: firelookout.com says destroyed 1962; Forest Lookouts lists the tower as removed

evidence.supports: 16 miles northwest of St. Regis, Lolo National Forest
Forest Lookouts lists the tower as removed
FFLA Montana county list shows Cameron Peak as Tower Gone

corrections.why: A latitude of 39.3 lies south of Montana, whose southern border is about 45 degrees north; the FFLA list places Cameron Peak in Mineral County, Montana at 47.44331, -115.36447.

resolved_conflicts.field: how the tower left the site
resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says destroyed in 1962; Forest Lookouts says Removed; FFLA says Tower Gone. No source gives a method or a removal date other than 1962.

notes_for_editor: Only three short listings were found; the 1936 build and 1962 destruction rest on one line from firelookout.com. No staffing, access or present-day source was found. The record coordinates are wrong (see corrections). A Visit Montana listing for a Cameron Peak Trail appeared in search but was not read.
